headline: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini, Apache-2.0 looped MoE for local use
quote: The model is distributed as a single checkpoint of about 20GB, in mixed NVFP4 and MXFP8 precisions.
claim: The Inkling 2 Mini card lists 26.4B parameters (3.4B active, 5.4B effective with three loop passes), a 1M-token context, a roughly 20GB checkpoint and an Apache-2.0 licence. It names Apple silicon with 32GB or more memory and DGX Spark as supported local hardware.
why_it_matters: A multimodal open model with a 1M context and a stated 32GB-Mac target is something a student with a decent laptop can try.
title: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini · Hugging Face

headline: Unsloth publishes GGUF quantisations of Inkling 2 Mini
claim: Unsloth's GGUF repo for Inkling 2 Mini (Apache-2.0) shows how to run the UD-Q4_K_M quant with llama.cpp, Ollama and Docker Model Runner.
why_it_matters: One command pulls a quantised build into llama.cpp or Ollama, so you can test the model without converting weights yourself.
title: unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF · Hugging Face

headline: Tencent publishes Hy4-flash weights: 220B total, 12B active, 1M context
quote: featuring 220B total parameters (including 64B Engram parameters) with just 12B active parameters per token.
claim: Tencent's Hy4-flash card describes a 220B-parameter model with 12B active per token, text and image input and up to 1M tokens of context. The licence shown is tencent-hy-license, not a standard open licence.
why_it_matters: Weights are open to download but the custom licence needs reading before any project use; it is too large for laptops.
title: tencent/Hy4-flash · Hugging Face
